scope: Audit and BGS-only repair after stopping the fresh firefly-nightwatch paid run

accepted: Give the autonomous checker its own help/default entry. Retain explicit legacy commands, eight-domain design responsibilities and the old delivery entry; do not delete generated sidecars or rewrite project history.
Accept either a standalone Camera input or the existing scene-2d envelope. Reuse authored Camera selection and geometry, with source-specific errors rather than another layout algorithm.
Expose the optional browser consumer's actual signatures, result shapes and lifecycle without requiring the generated bundle to be read. Do not choose a renderer/engine or install it automatically.

Put receipt ID and check status before verbose diagnostic details. Preserve every selected probe identity, failure cause, current task text, Skill facts and historical measurement identity. Omit only passed text-fit detail from compact responses; full saved observations stay available.

Record actual browser viewport, DPR, touch and pointer conditions, plus declared probe activation paths. Accept optional deviceScaleFactor, keeping the default at 1. Compare screenshot pixels in CSS coordinates; backing-store size is evidence, not a requirement that it equal CSS size.
rejectedOrDeferred: Removing the full current task from compact measurement inspection was prototyped and withdrawn during audit: a child may have no parent history, so identity alone cannot replace its authorization source.
No automatic context reset, tool/turn limit, extra Review prompt or Skill-loading mandate. These would not establish correct testing or visual quality.
No generic parser that treats arbitrary project report booleans or process exit 0 as full-game acceptance. Existing host receipts remain quality=unverified and deliveryEligible=false.
No attempt to automatically recognize teleports, resource refills or all valid player routes from arbitrary game code. A selected activation path is not complete player-flow coverage.
No automatic visual-taste/light-effect grader. The bound-image pixel probe still does not cover arbitrary procedural Canvas lighting.
compatibilityAndSideEffects: The legacy checker interface remains explicitly callable, including --design-handoff-help; only the autonomous default help excludes those old handoff instructions.
Camera inspection supports scene-2d only in addition to the existing Camera input. Invalid/ambiguous/missing authored cameras stay errors; no input is repaired.
No DPR matrix runs automatically. Untested pixel densities and gameplay remain unverified; callback environment observations are not automatically rewritten into project reports.

Pixel driver version moves from v3-canvas-image-consumption.2 to .3. Historical receipts remain readable but are not current evidence for the changed driver; no automatic rerun is issued. Other checker versions are unchanged.
Existing paid projects and running services have not been migrated or restarted. Real Agent adoption, game quality and Token savings are not established by these offline tests.

typecheck.scope: Repository root tsconfig with workspace aliases; no configuration or Claude Code source was modified

standalonePackageTypecheck.reason: This package config lacks the root workspace aliases needed by cross-package imports. Used the existing root typecheck instead; did not expand the task to alter package/native configuration.

initialDiagnosticFailures: Chromium was initially blocked by the command sandbox. Offline browser tests were rerun with execution permission; no browser isolation flag was disabled.
The first DPR regression exposed the old backing-store-equals-CSS-size precondition. This was corrected in the BGS pixel driver, then both good and bad synthetic renderers were rechecked.
The first root typecheck found a missing union-property guard in the new compact-response test. Added the guard, reran that test, and the complete root typecheck passed.
